features.line: It has a carbon-fiber roof, which keeps the weight down low.
The M Sport differential helps it put the power down coming out of corners.
M Drive Professional adds a lap timer and the M Drift Analyzer for track days.
Adaptive M suspension goes from comfortable to track-ready at the push of a button.
The M Carbon bucket seats hold you in like a race car.
It has M Sport brakes, so it stops as hard as it goes.
Inside, it has real carbon-fiber trim.
The M Shadowline headlights give the front a darker, meaner look.
Even the seat belts have the M stripes woven in.
